title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: In the context of one-hot encoding, each category of a categorical variable is represented by a binary variable. For example, if the meat is chicken, then the variable $$'meat=chicken'$$ will be $$1$$, and all other meat variables will be $$0$$.
